hooks.command: node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||"";process.stdout.write(f)}catch(e){}})' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" </dev/null 2>/dev/null; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" </dev/null 2>/dev/null;; esac; fi; } || true
